name: coconut

relevance.justification: Directly aligned with MyChem.info chemical entity type. Covers 695K+ natural product structures with InChIKey, SMILES, InChI, molecular formula, and 20+ computed molecular descriptors (MW, alogp, TPSA, QED, Lipinski). Uses standard chemical identifiers. Structured tabular data. Actively maintained with monthly releases.

novelty.justification: Natural product chemical space is largely distinct from DrugBank/ChEMBL (synthetic drugs) and PubChem (general compounds). Unique annotations not in BioThings: NPLikeness scores, NP Classifier pathway/superclass/class annotations, organism/species provenance with ontology mapping (EMBL-EBI OLS4, Global Names Finder), collection provenance from 63+ specialized NP databases, Murcko frameworks, annotation confidence stars (1-5). Some overlap with PubChem for well-known NPs and ChEBI NP subset, but COCONUT's NP-specific annotation layer is novel.

openness.justification: CC0 1.0 license (public domain dedication). Direct bulk CSV download from canonical S3 endpoint without login or API key. No paywall or click-through gate. License confirmed on download page: 'Creative Commons CC0 license, allowing for free use, modification, and distribution without any restrictions.'

evidence.scope: Natural product chemical structures with identifiers (InChIKey, SMILES, InChI, COCONUT_ID), molecular properties (MW, exact_MW, alogp, TPSA, QED, NP-likeness, FractionCSP3, Lipinski HBA/HBD, rotatable bonds, aromatic rings, formal charge, sugar flags), chemical classification (ClassyFire class/subclass/superclass/direct_parent), NP classifier annotations (pathway, superclass, class, is_glycoside), organism/species sources, collection provenance from 63+ databases, CAS numbers, DOIs, synonyms, IUPAC names, Murcko frameworks
evidence.overlap: Some overlap with PubChem for well-known natural products. ChEBI NP subset partially covers common NPs. No existing BioThings source provides NPLikeness scores, NP Classifier pathway annotations, or organism/collection provenance at this scale.

risks: Download URL contains dated path (2026-05); will need updating on each new monthly release
Lite CSV (4 columns) vs full CSV (44 columns) — must use full CSV; version.py must detect current release from download page
Large dataset (738K rows) requires streaming parser
